description: Point in polygon check and GeoJSON geometry: point-in-polygon with correct hole handling, bounding box, centroid, signed area in square metres, perimeter length, and ring winding order for a geometry supplied in the request. Accepts Polygon and MultiPolygon, and a GeoJSON Feature wrapping either. Area and length are geodesic on the WGS-84 ellipsoid, correct at any latitude; containment is planar in lon/lat. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

geometry.description: URL-encoded GeoJSON Polygon, MultiPolygon or a Feature wrapping one. At most 3072 characters and 2000 coordinate pairs. Accepted: valid GeoJSON.

lat.description: Point latitude; with lon, runs the containment test. Accepted: a number between -90 and 90.

lon.description: Point longitude; with lat, runs the containment test. Accepted: a number between -180 and 180.

ops.description: Comma-separated subset of contains,bbox,centroid,area,perimeter,winding. Default all. Accepted: comma-separated subset of contains, bbox, centroid, area, perimeter, winding.

name: point_in_polygon
title: Point in polygon check, plus bounding box, centroid and area for GeoJSON
